title: Furnace on, but no heat? 2-minute check
audience: Homeowners in Lubbock and the South Plains with a furnace, on Instagram or Facebook Reels during the first cold weeks of fall

scenes.text: Furnace running, but the house is still cold? Check this first.
Here is a two minute check. Start at the thermostat. Is it set to heat? If not, switch it. If it is, look at the filter. Dirty? Replace it. Clean, and still cold? Call BTAC.
